prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, shaggy layered ash brown hair — wearing a deep burgundy velvet micro halter bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups joined by a small metal ring at the center, thin deep burgundy velvet halter strings tied behind her neck, and a minimal low-rise deep burgundy velvet bottom of one tiny opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque pieces fully covering her, her stomach bare. Her left leg wears a black fishnet thigh-high stocking with a wide lace-trimmed top band, the diamond mesh hugging her left thigh, knee, calf and ankle and running down into her heel, her blue-black skin showing through every opening of the net, matching the rest of her body. Her right leg wears a glossy deep-red latex thigh-high stocking with a thin elastic top band, stretched over her right thigh, knee, calf and ankle with mirror shine and fine pull-creases at the knee, completely opaque and running down into her heel. Her left arm wears a wide black leather band with a small silver buckle and a silver ring at the outer side, snug on her left upper arm, her forearm and hand bare. Her right arm is bare from the shoulder to the fingertips. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of deep burgundy velvet, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in glossy deep burgundy lacquer with a high polish.
Body paint: a gold botanical vine with small leaves and buds winding in a spiral from the wrist up to the shoulder, painted directly on the skin, covering her entire right arm only, a fine opaque painted pattern on the bare skin of that arm.
Piercing: a large gold navel hoop with a big white pearl, resting directly on her skin at her navel.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and large drop earrings of mixed metals, a long silver chain ending in a heavy gold anvil-shaped weight on each ear, hanging above her collarbones. Jewelry is metal and pearl only.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips.

Background: a sunny plaza at the foot of glass skyscrapers with pale paving, a low fountain edge, standard-height glass doors and benches, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
